Father, Mother.
We decided to leave the valley quickly.

Now that we have all the gems,
it would be very dangerous
to stay in one place.
1: Leaving without a word feels a bit bad.
2: We have no choice. We can't tell them everything.

46:
Adin persuaded the seven tribes
and gathered the gems.

He set them in a belt he forged
and fastened it around his waist.

The Belt blazed as bright as the sun.
47:
In its light, the seven tribes of
Deltora united and fought.

And so the Shadow Lord was driven away.
50: So we believe. If the seven tribes gather, the Belt will show its true power…
51: I see… Very well. The Resistance will find the seven tribes. We'll send word of where to meet.
53: Hmph. We both hate the Shadow Lord. That much we share.
55: Say, Doom. What happened to Dain?

60: Yes. Especially if Dain's the true heir.

68: I see… The king can't have gone far from Del.
69: I don't think he's still there. But there may be some clue to where he went.
73: Have you found the blacksmith's son?
75: Listen. Take them alive. The Shadow Lord himself wishes to execute them. I think we'll make the son watch the blacksmith and his wife die… Heh heh heh.
76: Heh heh heh… Ha ha ha ha!
79: So Father and Mother are still alive… Right?
82: I think it was the Chief Adviser… but that's strange. He should be Prandine, Chief Adviser in Endon's time. And I heard Jarred killed Prandine 16 years ago.
86: Oh yes, there's a brat calling himself the royal heir. Cut him down on sight.

92: Could it be… Dain's acting as a decoy… He's drawing the Shadow Lord's attention to himself.

98: Yes, you're right. We'll stay hidden.
102: There are Guards this way! Let's go back!

I am cold and hungry.
My wife and child are already dead.
I will soon follow.
The royal house ends with me.

       Endon, last king of Deltora
111: Yes. It bears the king's seal.
113: (The king, the queen… and the heir…) (All gone from this world, long ago…)

Touch a house on the left or right
to open the way.
Haven't we seen that person before…?

156: So it seems. You're a simple pair.
158: (I was working it out as I spoke.)
